verdict.rationale: The pack documents spend rules, velocity controls, and collaborative authorization, which let a subscriber build its own approve/decline logic, plus compliance-team transaction monitoring. These are adjacent controls and building blocks, not documented fraud capabilities. Nothing shows network fraud scores or Highnote fraud models at authorization time, suspicious-activity alerts, or tooling to block and reissue compromised cards.

support.subject: As an ops user, the platform fights fraud on my issued cards — network fraud scores or its own models surfaced at auth time, suspicious-activity alerts, and tooling to block and reissue compromised cards
